run_metadata.prompt: Write a complete, idiomatic Python implementation of a binary search tree with insert, delete, search, traversal, height, docstrings, and tests. Code only.

timing_definition.ttft: request start to first nonempty SSE token/chunk
timing_definition.itl: intervals between subsequent nonempty SSE token/chunk arrivals
timing_definition.tpot: mean of subsequent nonempty SSE arrival intervals
timing_definition.post_ttft_decode_rate: secondary c1 cross-check: (server generation token delta - first token) / (request wall time - TTFT)
timing_definition.server_request_decode_rate: primary: delta generation_tokens_total / delta request_decode_time_seconds_sum; excludes prefill and is not inverse ITL
timing_definition.server_request_prefill_rate: delta prompt_tokens_total / delta request_prefill_time_seconds_sum; prefix-cache hit delta must be considered separately
